_comment: Onboarding wizard, native emtk window. Drawn by emtk.view_form over BoardingModel (model.py). 'navigation' is the Back / Next / Finish bar, 'confirm' the question Restore defaults asks, and one panel per step of the Qt wizard (named by the step id). The step texts are Markdown drawn by the 'markdown' custom section, the repair outcome by 'repair_status', and the detector and FCS steps embed the shared channel-definition and FCS-preset editors through the 'detector_editor' and 'fcs_editor' custom sections, drawn by app.py.
title: Welcome to ChiSurf

sections.title: Navigation
sections.name: navigation
sections.description: Walk the steps in order: Back, Next, and Finish on the last step.
Back goes to the previous step, Next to the following one, and Finish (last step only) closes the wizard.

buttons.label: Back
buttons.description: Go to the previous step. Not available on the first step.

buttons.label: Next
buttons.description: Go to the following step. Every step can be skipped; nothing has to be completed first.

buttons.label: Finish
buttons.description: Close the wizard. You can run it again from the Plugin Manager.
